set.body: Add named Schaefer/Glasser surface acquisition adapters over existing GIFTI/FreeSurfer/CIFTI readers, preserving canonical parcel mapping and pinned asset integrity. Add atlas surface selection and scalar/series reduction using bilateral exact assignments and CorticalHemisphere. This extends beyond neuroatlas surface subset support. Acceptance: offline format fixtures, opposite hemisphere label conventions, explicit geometry/coverage failures, both-platform computation tests; asset-backed checks reported separately.
set.title: Atlas: add standard surface acquisition and field workflows
